candidates.label: Shaytan's operational methodology: systematic program of misleading arousing desires commanding alteration of divine creation
candidates.definition: In 4:119: Shaytan declares his program: I will mislead them, arouse sinful desires in them, command them to slit cattle ears, and command them to change Allah's creation. Taking him as ally instead of Allah is clear loss.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمۡ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمۡ وَلَأٓمُرَنَّهُمۡ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ ءَاذَانَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ وَلَأٓمُرَنَّهُمۡ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلۡقَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ وَلِيّٗا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ خَسِرَ خُسۡرَانٗا مُّبِينٗا
evidence.rationale: Walaodillannahum walaomanniyannahum walaamurannahum falayubattikunna athana alanAAami walaamurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqa Allahi: four-part declaration of satanic methodology. Misleading (idlal), desire-arousal (tamniya), ritual innovation (ear-slitting), and ontological alteration (taghyeer khalq Allah). Khusranan mubeenan: clear quantifiable loss.

candidates.urduLabel: منهجية الشيطان: برنامج منظم للتضليل وإثارة الشهوات وتغيير خلق الله
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Most detailed Quranic exposition of satanic modus operandi. Four operations target different human vulnerabilities: cognitive (misleading), appetitive (desires), ritual (innovation), ontological (altering nature). Taghyeer khalq Allah suggests bioethical dimension relevant to contemporary debates. Clear loss framing makes alliance calculus explicit.

candidates.label: Salvation insufficiency of wishful thinking: neither Muslim nor People of Scripture aspirations substitute for accountability
candidates.definition: In 4:123: Paradise is not obtained by your wishful thinking nor by that of the People of the Scripture. Whoever does evil will be recompensed for it and will find no protector or helper besides Allah.

evidence.excerpt: لَّيۡسَ بِأَمَانِيِّكُمۡ وَلَآ أَمَانِيِّ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِۗ مَن يَعۡمَلۡ سُوٓءٗا يُجۡزَ بِهِۦ وَلَا يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Laysa biamaniyyikum wala amaniyyi ahli alkitabi: symmetric negation addressing both communities. Man yaAAmal sooan yujza bihi: universal accountability principle. Wala yajid lahu min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseeran: divine exclusivity in protection.

candidates.urduLabel: عدم كفاية الأماني: أماني المسلمين وأهل الكتاب لا تغني عن المحاسبة
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Deconstructs communal exceptionalism for both Muslims and People of Scripture. Amanni (wishful thinking/aspirations) distinguished from active righteousness. Universal recompense principle removes ethnic/confessional privilege. Solo divine guardianship eliminates intermediary reliance.

candidates.label: Gender-inclusive salvation: righteous deeds by male or female believer equally admitted to Paradise without injustice
candidates.definition: In 4:124: Whoever does righteous deeds whether male or female while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged even as much as the speck on a date seed.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ نَقِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Min thakarin aw ontha: explicit gender pairing. Wahuwa muminun: faith condition applies equally. Yadkhuloona aljannata: identical outcome. Wala yuthlamoona naqeeran: precision metaphor (date-seed speck) emphasizing zero-tolerance injustice.

candidates.urduLabel: شمولية الخلاص: العمل الصالح من ذكر أو أنثى مؤمنة يدخل الجنة
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Most explicit gender-parity soteriological statement in Quran. Naqeer (speck on date seed) provides concrete micro-measure of divine justice precision. Faith-plus-righteousness formula identical for both genders. Contrasts with pre-Islamic gender-differentiated spiritual valuations.

candidates.label: Orphan girls' marital rights: prohibition against marrying orphan wards while withholding prescribed shares
candidates.definition: In 4:127: They consult you about women. Say Allah instructs concerning orphan girls to whom you do not give what is prescribed for them yet you desire to marry them and concerning oppressed children and maintaining orphans justly.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَسۡتَفۡتُونَكَ فِي ٱلنِّسَآءِۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفۡتِيكُمۡ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ فِي يَتَٰمَى ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّـٰتِي لَا تُؤۡتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَتَرۡغَبُونَ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنِ وَأَن تَقُومُواْ لِلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۚ وَمَا تَفۡعَلُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Fee yatama alnnisai allatee la tutoonahunna ma kutiba lahunna watarghaboona an tankihoohunna: identifies specific abuse pattern - desiring marriage while withholding financial rights. WaalmustadAAafeena mina alwildani: extends protection to vulnerable children generally. Biqisti: justice standard.

candidates.urduLabel: حقوق اليتيمات الزوجية: النهي عن نكاحهن مع منع حقوقهن المفروضة
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Addresses intersection of guardianship power and marital desire creating conflict of interest. La tutoonahunna ma kutiba lahunna implies established written/prescribed entitlement being violated. Protection framed within broader orphan justice mandate. Historical context: pre-Islamic guardians marrying orphan wards for property absorption.

candidates.label: Polygamous equity limitation: acknowledged impossibility of perfect emotional equality with prohibition against total neglect
candidates.definition: In 4:129: You will never be able to be equal between wives even if you strive. So do not incline completely leaving one hanging. If you reform and fear Allah then Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَن تَسۡتَطِيعُوٓاْ أَن تَعۡدِلُواْ بَيۡنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتُمۡۖ فَلَا تَمِيلُواْ كُلَّ ٱلۡمَيۡلِ فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلۡمُعَلَّقَةِۚ وَإِن تُصۡلِحُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Walan tastateeAAoo an taAAdiloo bayna alnnisai walaw harastum: categorical impossibility statement despite effort. Fala tameeloo kulla almayli fatatharooha kaalmuAAallaqati: behavioral boundary preventing total abandonment. KaalmuAAallaqati: vivid metaphor of suspended/unattached state.

candidates.urduLabel: حدود العدل بين الزوجات: استحالة المساواة العاطفية مع تحريم الإهمال الكلي
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Psychological realism distinguishes emotional equity (impossible) from behavioral equity (required). MuAAallaqah (suspended) captures liminal suffering of neglected co-wife. Reform-plus-taqwa pathway acknowledges inevitable shortfall while maintaining accountability. Ghafooran Raheema closure provides mercy framework for acknowledged human limitation.

candidates.label: Absolute justice imperative: persistent standing firm for justice as witnesses for Allah overriding self-interest kinship and class
candidates.definition: In 4:135: O believers be persistently standing firm in justice witnesses for Allah even against yourselves or parents or relatives whether rich or poor Allah is more worthy of both. Do not follow inclination lest you avoid justice.

evidence.excerpt: ۞يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُواْ قَوَّـٰمِينَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَوِ ٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَۚ إِن يَكُنۡ غَنِيًّا أَوۡ فَقِيرٗا فَٱللَّهُ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهِمَاۖ فَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعۡدِلُواْۚ وَإِن تَلۡوُۥٓاْ أَوۡ تُعۡرِضُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
evidence.rationale: Koonoo qawwameena bialqisti: intensive form (qawwameena) implies institutional persistence not occasional action. Shuhadaa lillahi: witnessing framed as divine service. Walaw AAala anfusikum awi alwalidayni waalaqrabeena: three-tier override hierarchy (self parents kin). In yakun ghaniyyan aw faqeeran: class neutrality. FaAllahu awla bihima: divine priority over human loyalty.

candidates.urduLabel: أمر العدالة المطلق: القيام بالقسط شهداء لله فوق المصلحة الذاتية والقرابة والطبقة
candidates.notes: Overlap with justice (scholarly) as primary textual anchor. Qawwameena (persistent upholders) stronger than mere 'doers'. Three-tier override creates graduated loyalty test. Class-neutrality clause prevents economic capture of justice. Hawa (inclination) identified as systemic threat to judicial integrity.

candidates.label: Repeated apostasy cycle: belief-disbelief-belief-disbelief escalation resulting in permanent divine abandonment
candidates.definition: In 4:137: Those who believed then disbelieved then believed then disbelieved then increased in disbelief - Allah will never forgive them nor guide them to a way.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ ٱزۡدَادُواْ كُفۡرٗا لَّمۡ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا لِيَهۡدِيَهُمۡ سَبِيلَۢا
evidence.rationale: Amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma izdadoo kufran: five-stage oscillation pattern culminating in intensification (izdadoo). Lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum: categorical forgiveness denial. Wala liyahdiyahum sabeelan: guidance pathway permanently closed.

candidates.urduLabel: دورة الردة المتكررة: الإيمان ثم الكفر ثم الإيمان ثم الكفر تؤدي إلى الهجران الإلهي الدائم
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Distinguishes single apostasy from chronic oscillation pattern. Five-stage sequence suggests deliberate testing rather than sincere struggle. Izdadoo kufran (increased disbelief) marks qualitative shift from vacillation to entrenchment. Permanent closure contrasts with open repentance pathways elsewhere. Psychological profile: instrumental faith treating belief as tactical option.

candidates.label: Sacrilege withdrawal protocol: mandatory departure from company denying or mocking divine ayat until topic changes
candidates.definition: In 4:140: It has been revealed in the Book that when you hear Allah's ayat denied and mocked do not sit with them until they enter different conversation otherwise you are like them. Allah will gather hypocrites and disbelievers in Hell together.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَدۡ نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَنۡ إِذَا سَمِعۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يُكۡفَرُ بِهَا وَيُسۡتَهۡزَأُ بِهَا فَلَا تَقۡعُدُواْ مَعَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُواْ فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيۡرِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا مِّثۡلُهُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ جَامِعُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعًا
evidence.rationale: Waqad nazzala AAalaykum fee alkitabi: references prior revelation establishing continuity. Itha samiAAtum ayati Allahi yukfaru biha wayustahzao biha: two offenses identified (denial plus mockery). Fala taqAAudoo maAAahum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi: temporal boundary tied to topic change. Innakum ithan mithluhum: equivalence principle making presence complicity.

candidates.urduLabel: بروتوكول الانسحاب من مجالس الاستهزاء: وجوب مغادرة مجلس إنكار آيات الله
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Establishes social hygiene boundary against sacrilege normalization. Dual trigger (kufr + istihza) covers intellectual rejection and emotional ridicule. Temporal limit (hatta yakhoodoo) prevents permanent isolationism. Mithluhum (like them) collapses distinction between active mocker and passive audience. Eschatological consequence reinforces social boundary.

candidates.label: Selective belief invalidity: distinguishing between Allah and His messengers constitutes true disbelief not partial faith
candidates.definition: In 4:150-151: Those who disbelieve in Allah and His messengers wishing to distinguish between them saying we believe in some and reject some wanting a middle way - those are the disbelievers truly and We have prepared for disbelievers humiliating punishment.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يُفَرِّقُواْ بَيۡنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَيَقُولُونَ نُؤۡمِنُ بِبَعۡضٖ وَنَكۡفُرُ بِبَعۡضٖ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
evidence.rationale: Yureedoona an yufarriqoo bayna Allahi warusulihi: intentional separation identified. Nu/minu bibaAAdin wanakfuru bibaAAdin: selective creed quoted directly. Yattakhithoo bayna thalika sabeelan: middle-way aspiration diagnosed as strategic compromise.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ حَقّٗاۚ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
evidence.rationale: Olaika humu alkafiroona haqqan: emphatic classification as true disbelievers. AAathaban muheenan: humiliating punishment matches humiliation of rejected messengers.

candidates.urduLabel: بطلان الإيمان الانتقائي: التفريق بين الله ورسله كفر حقيقي لا إيمان جزئي
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Deconstructs cafeteria-style religiosity. Separation of Allah from messengers treated as structural disbelief not gradation. Haqqan (truly) removes ambiguity about classification. Muhinan (humiliating) punishment mirrors dignity violation of selective acceptance. Targets both historical Jewish-Christian partial recognition and modern spiritual-but-not-religious positions.

candidates.label: Divine punishment non-necessity: Allah has no interest in punishment when gratitude and belief are present
candidates.definition: In 4:147: What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allah Appreciative and Knowing.

evidence.excerpt: مَّا يَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابِكُمۡ إِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ وَءَامَنتُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ شَاكِرًا عَلِيمٗا
evidence.rationale: Ma yafAAalu Allahu biAAathabikum: rhetorical question implying answer 'nothing'. In shakartum waamantum: two sufficient conditions named. Shakiran AAaleema: divine appreciation paired with knowledge suggesting responsive rather than arbitrary disposition.

candidates.urduLabel: عدم حاجة الله للعذاب: لا مصلحة إلهية في العقاب مع وجود الشكر والإيمان
candidates.notes: Gap candidate. Fundamental theological statement on divine motivation. Rhetorical question format invites listener to recognize punishment absurdity given gratitude-belief. Shakir (Appreciative) frames Allah as responsive to human moral effort rather than detached sovereign. Contrasts with retributive-only theologies. Establishes gratitude-belief as sufficient condition for divine non-punishment.
